result.reason: The clause appropriately replaces the no-hire with a mutual non-solicit, limits it to personnel directly involved in the services, and includes general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. However, the restriction runs through 12 months after termination of the Agreement, rather than 12 months after each individual’s involvement ends, so it is broader than the fallback position. The margin comment does not cure this operative-language defect.
